scope: The main Château de Cheverny in its circa 2010 appearance. Includes the limestone front and rear walls, five roof masses, two large square pavilions and attached front stairs. The separate commons, kennel, gardens, and interiors are outside the model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Ministry of Culture identifies the rectangular central block, flanking wings and large square pavilions, and distinguishes the existing château from the earlier manor’s surviving outbuildings.
